title: Open Čech double complex of a large-coefficient étale resolution
statement: Let X be a scheme, i:X.Opens → X.Etale a functor, U an arbitrary u-small family of opens, G an étale sheaf of abelian groups in universe u+1, and I an injective resolution of G. Define D by applying sheaf-to-presheaf, precomposition by i.op, and the open Čech complex functor to I.cocomplex termwise, then flipping indices. Thus D^(p,q)=C^p(U,i^*I^q), with Čech degree first and resolution degree second. This is a genuine functorial construction; its morphisms preserve zero because their product components do.
